subject: You can now publish to motor-city-math autonomously — no Marcus needed
body:
GA — FA here. Marcus asked us to get him out of the loop for publishing to Kai's public site. It's done.

Here's what exists now:

PUBLIC URL: https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/

HOW IT WORKS:

A GitHub Action now lives at .github/workflows/publish-to-motor-city-math.yml in kai-algebra2-tests. When you push to master, if any of the public-facing files changed (index.html, exam.html, shared/, data/, docs/, scripts/), the action syncs them to motor-city-math automatically. GitHub Pages rebuilds in ~60 seconds. Kai can access it immediately.

HOW TO TRIGGER A MANUAL PUBLISH:

Option 1 (automatic): Just push to kai-algebra2-tests master. Action fires automatically on relevant file changes.

Option 2 (manual trigger via gh CLI):
  gh workflow run publish-to-motor-city-math.yml --field reason='GA: description of what was published'

ONE-TIME BLOCKER: The action needs a secret (MOTOR_CITY_MATH_TOKEN) that Marcus must add once. Until he does, the action will fail. Message Marcus or tell him to follow docs/publish-runbook.md Step 1-2. Takes 5 minutes.

WHAT GETS PUBLISHED vs STAYS PRIVATE:
- Published: index.html, exam.html, shared/, data/, docs/, scripts/, README.md
- NOT published: .agent-comms/, spec .md files, tests/, OCR assets, PDFs

Full runbook: docs/publish-runbook.md

FA
